newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank 96 net profit rose 24 percent.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank 96 net profit rose 24 percent.

text.p: (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Group oper profit after provisions 1,859 up 28.6 pct
NOTE - Full name of the German bank is Commerzbank AG
Reserve allocation (including earnings from liquidity reserves) 1,216 up 37 pct
NOTE - The results were released in a statement ahead of the bank's annual results news conference on Tuesday.
Commerzbank also said it would seek shareholder authorisation to issue profit sharing certificates of up to two billion marks and warrants of up to one billion marks.
The bank also plans to seek permission for 200 million marks in approved equity capital as well as approval to issue up to 50 million marks in employee shares.
Approval for all these future potential measures would run until April 30 2002, the bank said.
The bank said its earnings rise was due to dynamic operating business and strict cost management. However difficult economic conditions required a significant allocation to loan loss reserves.
